posts.title: Why build Sasquach lang
posts.description: I'm writing a new functional programming language called Sasquach that targets the Java Virtual Machine (JVM). This post aims to answer why I'm building it, why I'm not just using another language, the goals and non-goals of the language, and why it's targeting the JVM.
